title: Compare true and decoded coordinates
description: You inspect the simulated and Viterbi paths in the same coordinate format.

steps.description: You convert each true state index to a row-column pair using ij and W. The list preserves the order of true_states.
You print the converted true path. Its first recorded position is (3,4).

steps.question: Does the recorded Viterbi path start at the true initial position?
steps.answer: It starts at (4,5), while the true path starts at (3,4). The initial positions differ.

steps.description: You compare the two printed sequences entry by entry. They share several later positions, but their final positions differ: true ends at (2,5) and Viterbi ends at (0,6).
